title: Champurrado (Mexican Hot Chocolate)
description: Champurrado is a thick, hot chocolate drink made with Mexican chocolate, pinole, piloncillo, and cinnamon to create a warm and delicious cozy drink.
ingredients: 2 tablets Mexican chocolate (such as Chocolate Ibarra®)
1 pinch crushed piloncillo (Mexican brown sugar cone), or more to taste

steps.text: Place water, cinnamon stick, clove, and star anise in a saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and allow spices to steep until water is fragrant, about 10 minutes; strain.

Heat milk, chocolate, and pinole in a separate saucepan over medium heat, whisking until chocolate is dissolved and liquid is thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat; add piloncillo and let rest until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes more. Pour cinnamon water into chocolate mixture and stir to combine.
